_comment: Owner-approval record for the SCHEDULE source behind automatic NBA / NHL DFS slates (DFS-AUTO-19, ADR-DFS-025). NBA and NHL automatic slates are built only when their entry is 'approved' WITH approvedOn (YYYY-MM-DD) and evidence (where the owner's decision is recorded); anything else fails closed and /dfs says 'awaiting owner approval of the schedule source'. NFL automatic slates do not read this file. The pending decision is cross-referenced in docs/game-day/SOURCE_ACCESS_EVIDENCE_2026-09-25.md. To approve: set approval to 'approved', fill approvedOn and evidence, deploy. Read by src/dfs/auto/approval.py.
